product_overview: Bora App is a multi-role delivery, takeaway, dine-in, and reservations platform operating in Guarda, Portugal. It connects clients, drivers, and partners through Supabase-backed auth, realtime order tracking, payments, and operational workflows.
core_goals: Enable secure role-based signup, login, and account recovery for clients, drivers, and partners.
Support end-to-end order lifecycle management from order creation through dispatch, pickup, delivery, and cancellation.
Process payments through Stripe card payments, MB Way, cash settlement, refunds, and extra charges.
Maintain wallet, refund credit, and loyalty token balances with correct expiry and redemption behavior.
Coordinate driver operations including offer acceptance, rejection, heartbeat updates, and delivery completion.
Allow partner onboarding and restaurant asset uploads with approval and validation checks.
Deliver push notifications to clients, drivers, and partners for operational events.
Enforce PostgreSQL RLS policies so users can only access their permitted data.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can sign up, log in, reset passwords, and delete their accounts across client, driver, and partner roles.
user_flows: POST /auth/v1/signup with valid client email and password -> Receive 200 with new Supabase user and client role metadata -> POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with the same credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and authenticated session
POST /functions/v1/support-password-reset with a known or unknown email -> Receive 200 with neutral success response -> User receives password reset email only if the email exists
POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with invalid credentials -> Receive 400/401 authentication error -> User remains unauthenticated and cannot access protected endpoints
POST /functions/v1/delete-account with a valid JWT -> Receive 200 confirming account deletion -> Subsequent authenticated requests with the same token fail due to deleted account

features.name: Order Lifecycle
features.description: Clients create orders and the system dispatches, cancels, and transitions orders through the approved status workflow.
user_flows: POST /rest/v1/orders with authenticated client data and valid order payload -> Receive 201 with created order record -> POST /functions/v1/dispatch-engine with {"order_id":"<order_id>"} -> Receive 200 with dispatched:true and optional driver_offered_id

POST /rest/v1/orders with authenticated client data -> Receive 201 with created order record -> POST /functions/v1/client-cancel-order with {"order_id":"<order_id>"} before driver acceptance -> Receive 200 with cancelled:true and refund details

POST /rest/v1/orders with authenticated client data -> Receive 201 with created order record -> POST /functions/v1/client-cancel-order with {"order_id":"<order_id>"} after driver acceptance -> Receive 200 with cancelled:true and fee/refund outcome
POST /functions/v1/admin-cancel-order with an authenticated non-admin JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error -> Order remains unchanged and no cancellation is applied

features.name: Payments
features.description: Customers can pay for orders using Stripe card or MB Way, while admins can refund and users can add extra charges or pay wallet debt.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/create-payment-intent with order_id, amount, and currency for a valid order -> Receive 200 with client_secret and payment_intent_id -> POST /functions/v1/stripe-webhook with a payment_intent.succeeded event -> Receive 200 acknowledged and order becomes paid/dispatchable

POST /functions/v1/create-mbway-payment-intent with valid order_id, amount, and phone_e164 -> Receive 200 with client_secret and payment_intent_id -> Stripe confirms payment via webhook -> Receive 200 from /functions/v1/stripe-webhook and order progresses to paid status
POST /functions/v1/create-payment-intent with an amount outside the allowed buffer or below Stripe minimum -> Receive 400 validation error -> No payment intent is created
POST /functions/v1/refund with a non-service_role or non-admin JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error -> No refund is issued

features.name: Wallet & Tokens
features.description: Clients can view wallet balances, and redeem promotional tokens that expire after 60 days.
user_flows: POST /rest/v1/rpc/wallet_get_balance with a valid authenticated user and p_user_id -> Receive 200 with free_cents, tokens_balance, and last_transactions -> User can see current wallet state

POST /rest/v1/rpc/client_redeem_promo_tokens with a valid promo code and authenticated user -> Receive 200 with tokens_applied and discount_cents -> Tokens balance decreases and order discount is applied
POST /rest/v1/rpc/get_user_tokens with a valid authenticated user -> Receive 200 with the active non-expired token sum -> Expired tokens are excluded from the total
POST /rest/v1/rpc/wallet_get_balance with an unauthenticated request -> Receive 401 authorization error -> Wallet data is not returned

features.name: Driver Operations
features.description: Drivers can accept or reject offers and send heartbeat updates containing location and battery information.
user_flows: POST /rest/v1/rpc/accept_offer with p_order_id and p_driver_id from the first eligible driver -> Receive 200 with accepted:true -> Order moves to driverAccepted and other drivers lose the offer
POST /rest/v1/rpc/driver_reject_offer with p_order_id and p_driver_id -> Receive 200 with rejected:true -> Dispatch can attempt the next eligible driver
POST /rest/v1/rpc/driver_heartbeat_by_id with p_driver_id, p_lat, p_lng, and p_battery -> Receive 200/204 success -> Driver location and battery are updated for realtime tracking
POST /rest/v1/rpc/accept_offer with a stale or already-claimed offer -> Receive error offer_unavailable or equivalent conflict response -> No second driver is assigned

features.name: Partner Management
features.description: Partners can register restaurants and upload restaurant assets after authentication, with IBAN validation and bucket-based storage.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/register-partner with valid email, password, restaurant details, and PT IBAN -> Receive 200/201 with partner registration success -> Partner account is created with approval pending

POST /functions/v1/upload-restaurant-asset with authenticated partner JWT and a valid file payload -> Receive 200 with storage path or upload confirmation -> Restaurant hero/logo/document asset is stored in the restaurants bucket
POST /functions/v1/register-partner with an invalid IBAN format or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> Partner account is not created
POST /functions/v1/upload-restaurant-asset with no valid JWT -> Receive 401 authorization error -> File upload is rejected

features.name: Notifications
features.description: The backend sends push notifications to drivers and clients for dispatch and order updates, with fallback behavior for clients.
user_flows: POST /functions/v1/notify-driver with an authenticated service_role JWT, driver_id, order_id, and type -> Receive 200 acknowledgment -> Driver push notification is delivered as data-only FCM with alert channel behavior
POST /functions/v1/notify-client with an authenticated service_role JWT, user_id, title, and body -> Receive 200 acknowledgment -> Client receives FCM notification and email fallback if needed
POST /functions/v1/notify-client without the required authorization -> Receive 401/403 authorization error -> No notification is sent
POST /functions/v1/notify-driver with missing required payload fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> Notification dispatch is aborted

features.name: RLS Security (PostgreSQL policies)
features.description: Database access is restricted by role-aware Row-Level Security so users can only see or modify permitted records.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/orders with a valid client JWT -> Receive 200 with only that client's orders -> Orders belonging to other users are not returned
GET /rest/v1/ledger_entries with a valid driver JWT -> Receive 200 with only that driver's ledger entries -> Entries for other drivers remain hidden
PATCH /rest/v1/profiles with a valid user JWT attempting to change role fields -> Receive 200/204 for allowed fields only or RLS/trigger rejection for role changes -> admin role remains immutable
GET /rest/v1/orders without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> No order records are returned
